messages:
marie (docs): opened a tiny PR to update audit export docs with a compact field-level redaction example and TTL guidance: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701
jon (legal): quick note: avoid words like "permanent". use: "Audit artifacts are retained per-account according to configured retention settings and applicable legal holds." Also add contact for legal-hold requests.
marie (docs): added: "For legal-hold requests contact support@redwood.ai and your account rep. Legal holds override configured retention TTLs."
eli (security): please add one short line on export encryption + integrity (KMS + bundle hash). keep it brief.
siva (eng-ml): tiny JS redaction snippet for the PR: ```
for await (const r of client.audit.export({q: 'since:2025-01-01'})) {
  delete r.user_email;
  r.user_id = hashId(r.user_id);
  writeRedacted(r);
}
```
marie (docs): thanks — will swap "masking" -> "field-level redaction" per legal and update the API path to /v1/audit/logs/export (runtime change). added TTL header examples (90d, 365d) and a combined curl+python chain for QA.
docs-bot: PR 701 opened by marie (docs) — reviewers requested: jon, eli, siva.
qa: the curl+python example is helpful for reproduction. can we keep it one-liner?
marie (docs): combined example kept compact in PR. CI: linkcheck/preview pending.
ci-bot: preview published: https://deploy-preview-701--docs.redwood.ai/audit-export-guide
jon (legal): LGTM after minor wording tweak: replace "suspend automated deletion" with "override automated deletion".
marie (docs): applied wording change, CI green, merging. release note: "docs: clarify audit exports, add field-level redaction examples and TTL/KMS guidance"
eli (security): follow-up: if enterprise customers need HSM wording expand, ping security.
